identity.tagline: A vetted-only contractor club where work history is system-generated, the contract is a living container, and the whole machine plugs into the Board hire seam.
identity.problem: Freelance marketplaces optimize for self-promotion; the real signal — did this person do the work, on time, under contract — is buried. Reely already generates work (Board projects, BDA strategy); it needs a trusted supply side that plugs straight into that work via contract-granted access.
identity.primaryUser: A vetted contractor: browses the job-feed, bids, signs contracts, runs the timer, gets paid, and maintains a public profile.
identity.currentSolution: Upwork/Fiverr-style marketplaces + manual hand-off; nothing ties a contractor's record to actual platform work or into a hire seam.
identity.coreWedge: Vetted membership + system-driven work history + a living contract bound directly into Board through build-time contracts. Reputation is the actual Reely work record.

deviations.reason: Per Reely-Identity-Model.md, Contractor is user-scoped and owns contractor_identity (a verified profile on the base User). There is no tenant overlay at all — simpler than Board's self-owned tenant. Access is user-scoped + participant-scoped.
Scoped to messaging + bid arrival; RLS-filtered by participant; delay-tolerant. Reuses the same RLS as the DB.

modules.name: Payments

emitsEvents.when: a cycle closes into the dispute window

modules.dependencyNotes: The financial core. Stripe Connect Express; weekly cycle; delayed platform-initiated charge after the dispute window; take-rate; payouts. Not escrow.
acceptanceCriteria: One billing_cycle per (contract_id, period_start); worker upserts, never duplicates
Charge only on dispute_window->charged, now > dispute_window_ends_at, no open dispute
Idempotent charge (idempotency_key + unique billing_cycle_id); webhook signature-verified + idempotent on event id
Cycle totals sum only approved time; take_rate stored on cycle + charge; net = gross - take_rate
Payout only after a succeeded charge; Express onboarding gates payout
N=1 path runs close -> window -> charge -> payout cleanly
All financial + webhook-signature + webhook-idempotency harness assertions pass

modules.name: Messaging

portfolioContracts._bindingNote: Contractor PROVIDES the four marketplace shapes Board consumes (currently deferred on Board's side). It consumes nothing for v1 — clients arrive as opaque Clerk User ids. The contractor-person reaching INTO Board is governed by Board's access-control grant on contract_ref, not by this node.
